verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant (for example, in a developer portal or dashboard) is a plausible capability for an API platform like this, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only an official MCP server and Agent Toolkit that let external AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) query Mastercard docs. That is a separate story about serving outside AI clients, and nothing documents an AI assistant built into the product to which users can delegate tasks.
